title: How LLMs Work
summary: From text to tokens to attention to probabilities: what actually happens inside a language model, and why it hallucinates.
outcomes: Explain next-token prediction, tokenization, and embeddings precisely
Describe self-attention and the transformer block at an intuitive level
Reason about sampling, temperature, and context windows
Distinguish pretraining, post-training, prompting, RAG, and fine-tuning, and explain hallucination

lessons.title: One task to rule them all: next-token prediction
